name: crowdstrike
description: Connect to CrowdStrike through its official MCP server.

research.notes: CrowdStrike hosts a remote MCP on its own domain, signed in through the Falcon API's OAuth server (US-1 host); it is not in public docs, and a user report of an MCP clients page in the Falcon console suggests an admin may need to allow the client. The local falcon-mcp (maintained by CrowdStrike, pre-1.0) is the documented fallback and uses an API client created in Support > API Clients and Keys. Falcon Go, Pro and Enterprise can be bought online per device (Go from $7.99 a month, up to 100 devices) or tried free for 15 days (the trial covers Falcon Prevent and Device Control); the pricing pages do not say which bundles include API access. Falcon is sold to businesses. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD yes, S256 yes.
